question: Which artifact properties accompany production curiosity and expressed desire to create?

dimensions.definition: Resemblance of depicted visuals to real camera footage in lighting, materials, anatomy and motion.
dimensions.anchor_1: Minimum observable degree of this property.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong resemblance to real camera footage.
dimensions.exclusions: Narrative plausibility, authenticity of authorship, or audience belief.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Density of concurrent visual elements, independent actions and changes to track.
dimensions.anchor_1: Minimum observable degree of this property.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Many simultaneous distinct visual elements and actions to track.
dimensions.exclusions: Technical production difficulty or audience cognitive load.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Departure of depicted events from ordinary expectations established by the scene.
dimensions.anchor_1: Minimum observable degree of this property.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Marked departure from the scene-established expectations.
dimensions.exclusions: Algorithm controllability or a particular viewer's surprise.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed desire to learn more about the content, meaning or events of the artifact.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Clear request for more information about its content.
dimensions.exclusions: Requests about production tools or techniques.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed desire to understand the tools, techniques or process used to make the artifact.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Explicit and strong interest in learning how it was made.
dimensions.exclusions: Claims about actual expertise or mere praise.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed pleasure or enjoyment from experiencing the artifact.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong, unambiguous pleasure in the experience.
dimensions.exclusions: Curiosity or an intention to create without expressed pleasure.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed wish to personally try making a similar type of creative artifact.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong, explicit wish to try creation personally.
dimensions.exclusions: Past creation, general praise, hypothetical ability, or advice to others.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed perception that the narrative world reflects the real world.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong, explicit expression of this perception.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed encounter with something different from what is regularly encountered.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong, explicit expression of this perception.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

dimensions.definition: Expressed algorithmic or artificial unpredictability and events exceeding expectations; historical definition mixes these targets.
dimensions.anchor_1: No expressed evidence of this response.
dimensions.anchor_5: Moderate, clear evidence of the defined dimension.
dimensions.anchor_10: Strong, explicit expression of this perception.
dimensions.rationale: Candidate operationalization for artifact exposure and creative motivation; requires construct review.

correspondence.rationale: Related but distinct visual and narrative realism targets.
Partial content overlap; historical unpredictability also includes generation-related meanings.
